Ten additional workflow lines close the adopter-delivery input contract between the floating alpha wrapper and the protected train shell while keeping the generated router current. Twenty-three reviewed workflow lines make tail reseal recreate and upload the exact source-, tree-, runtime-, signer-, platform-, and manifest-bound attestation policy required by downstream publication admission; the path still skips every native build job and fails closed when retained bytes drift. Twenty-eight reviewed workflow lines additionally hydrate that same exact original-run policy into publication evidence for a candidate already sealed before the transport repair, without changing product bytes or candidate identity.
